teaser.en: The red nimakoba: a bright-capped brittlegill that Digo women collect in the rains.
teaser.sw: Nimakoba mwekundu: uyoga wa jenasi *Russula* wenye kofia ya rangi angavu ambao wanawake wa Kidigo huukusanya wakati wa mvua.
teaser.dg: *Nimakoba* wa kundu: *Russula* yenye kofiya ya kundu inayong'ala, ambayo achetu a Chidigo anaitsola wakati wa mvula.

summary.en: Nimakoba wa kundu, the 'red nimakoba', is a red-capped brittlegill mushroom. Digo collectors tell it from the pale nimakoba mwereru by cap colour alone.
summary.sw: Nimakoba wa kundu, 'nimakoba mwekundu', ni uyoga wa jenasi *Russula* wenye kofia nyekundu. Wakusanyaji wa Kidigo huutofautisha na nimakoba mwereru uliofifia kwa rangi ya kofia peke yake.
summary.dg: *Nimakoba wa kundu*, '*nimakoba* wa kundu', ni uoga wa *Russula* wenye kofiya ya kundu. Adigo anaotsola uoga anautafwautisha na *nimakoba mwereru* kpwa rangi ya kofiya tu.

about.en:
*Nimakoba wa kundu* is a *Russula*, a brittlegill with a red to pinkish cap, pale gills and a white stem. The flesh is crumbly and snaps like chalk, and gives no milk.

Like all mushrooms it appears suddenly after rain and lasts only a few days.
about.sw:
*Nimakoba wa kundu* ni *Russula*, uyoga unaovunjika kwa urahisi wenye kofia nyekundu hadi ya waridi, matamvua yaliyofifia na shina jeupe. Nyama yake hubomoka na kukatika kama chaki, na haitoi maziwa.

Kama uyoga wote, huibuka ghafla baada ya mvua na hudumu siku chache tu.
about.dg:
*Nimakoba wa kundu* ni *Russula*, uoga unaovundzika rahisi, wenye kofiya ya kundu hadi pinki, miraba ya rangi ngushu-ngushu na muhi mwereru. Nyamaze zinavundzika-vundzika na kutika-tika dza chokaa, na taulavya maziya.

Dza uoga wosi, unatuluka gafula bada ya mvula na unakaa siku chache tu.

where.en: Brittlegills grow from the ground in woodland, linked to the roots of trees. Digo collectors know the *Brachystegia* woodland (*mirihini*), farmland (*mdani*) and termite mounds (*tsuluni*) as different mushroom grounds.
where.sw: Uyoga wa aina hii huota kutoka ardhini msituni, ukiungana na mizizi ya miti. Wakusanyaji wa Kidigo wanaujua msitu wa *Brachystegia* (*mirihini*), mashamba (*mdani*) na vichuguu (*tsuluni*) kama maeneo tofauti ya uyoga.
where.dg: Uoga wa *Russula* unamera kula photsi matsakani, phamwenga na mizi ya mihi. Adigo anaotsola uoga anamanya phatu phenye mirihi (*mirihini*), minda (*mdani*) na tsulu (*tsuluni*) kukala ni phatu phatafwauti pha kuphaha uoga.

uses.en: Local people collect and eat it, preferring young mushrooms with closed caps. Wild mushrooms should only be eaten when identified by someone with expert local knowledge.
uses.sw: Wenyeji huukusanya na kuula, wakipendelea uyoga mchanga wenye kofia zilizofunga. Uyoga wa porini unapaswa kuliwa tu ukiwa umetambuliwa na mtu mwenye ujuzi wa kina wa kienyeji.
uses.dg: Atu a phapha anautsola na kuurya, na anamendza uoga uchere mdide, wenye kofiya iriyofungbwa. Uoga wa weruni taufwaha kuriwa hadi umanyikane ni mutu mwenye ujuzi mkulu wa uoga wa phapha.

culture.en: Pakia found that Digo women, the mushroom gatherers, name and collect only the mushrooms their elders taught them were edible. Their knowledge of mushrooms follows the same pattern as their knowledge of vegetables: what can be eaten gets a name.
culture.sw: Pakia aligundua kuwa wanawake wa Kidigo, ambao ndio wakusanyaji wa uyoga, huipa majina na kukusanya uyoga tu ambao wazee wao waliwafundisha kuwa unalika. Ujuzi wao wa uyoga unafuata mtindo uleule wa ujuzi wao wa mboga: kinacholika hupewa jina.
culture.dg: Pakia waona kukala achetu a Chidigo, ambao ndio anaotsola uoga, anapha madzina na kutsola uoga tu ambao azehe ao anaafundza kukala unariwa. Ujuzi wao wa uoga unalunga njira iyo mwenga na ujuzi wao wa mboga: chitu chinachoriwa ndicho chinachophewa dzina.

names.en: Pakia records *nimakoba wa kundu*, 'red *nimakoba*'. *Kundu* is the Digo word for red. Its partner is *nimakoba mwereru*, the white one.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *nimakoba wa kundu*, '*nimakoba* mwekundu'. *Kundu* ni neno la Kidigo la rangi nyekundu. Mwenzake ni *nimakoba mwereru*, yule mweupe.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *nimakoba wa kundu*, '*nimakoba* wa kundu'. *Kundu* ni neno ra Chidigo ra rangi ya kundu. Nduguye ni *nimakoba mwereru*, ariye mwereru.

reason.sw: uyoga wa maziwa wa jamii moja
Brachystegia, mti wa msitu wa uyoga

mgombato: kundu red; nyekundu. Mkpwaphi nkuvwala shuka za kundu. A Maasai usually wears red clothes. (See: do, do-do-do)
